import random, sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen2, boundary, check, subprocess, time
rng = random.Random(31)
kinds = ['budget_tight','budget_short','cap_tight','cap_over']
reqs=[]; made=0; tries=0
while made < 120 and tries < 800:
    tries += 1
    base = gen2.gen(rng)
    base['budget'] = 98304
    base['failed_edges'] = []
    if boundary.min_migration_and_mlu(base) is None:
        continue
    kind = kinds[made % len(kinds)]
    v = boundary.variant(base, rng, kind)
    if v is None: continue
    made += 1
    reqs.append(v)
print('built', len(reqs), 'boundary instances from', tries, 'tries')
payload = ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in reqs).encode()
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'], input=payload, capture_output=True)
print('elapsed', round(time.time()-t0,2), 'rc', p.returncode)
lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
stats={}; fails=0
for req, line in zip(reqs, lines):
    resp=json.loads(line); stats[resp['status']]=stats.get(resp['status'],0)+1
    errs = check.check(req, resp, verbose=False)
    if errs:
        fails+=1; print('FAIL', errs); print(json.dumps(req)[:500])
        if fails>4: break
print('stats', stats, 'fails', fails)
print('stderr', p.stderr.decode()[:600])
"
